name: Jobjila
tagline: IT advisory, support, training and hiring.
description: Jobjila provides IT advisory, IT support, live online training and employer-paid IT recruitment in cloud and IT service management, delivered by practising consultants. Based in Noida, serving clients across India.

founder.name: Ms Puja
founder.bio: Ms Puja is the CEO and Organizer of Jobjila's advisory and training practice. With 15+ years of experience in IT advisory, infrastructure, and training delivery, she brings deep expertise in cloud platforms, IT service management, and enterprise solutions. Her background in computer science and continuous professional development ensures every engagement and every cohort meets the highest standards. If something goes wrong, she is the person who answers for it.

reviews.author: abhinaw jaiswal
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the Cloud Presales Training by Jobjila Academy! The training was practical, interactive and industry-focused. The real-world discussions around customer requirements, solution architecture, RFP/RFI, sizing, BoQ and presales scenarios made the sessions very valuable.

reviews.author: casestudy
reviews.text: Great experience with Jobjila Academy's Cloud Presales Training! The sessions were very practical and focused on real-world enterprise scenarios, including customer discovery, solution design, cloud architecture, RFP/RFI, BoQ and presales approach. I especially liked the practical, industry-oriented approach rather than just theory.
